about: Criterion 18 (docs/spec.md §B.10): texts that claim an emotion or ask for one to be recorded. Written by hand for the test, before its first run and after the library code it tests; every text, name and number is invented. None shares a word with the fixture's query, and each fits a key's cap of 256 bytes.

texts.text: The user is furious about the outage.
I am terrified and my heart is racing.
Everyone on the team is panicking right now.
The customer feels deeply betrayed and hopeless.
She is overjoyed, ecstatic, the happiest she has ever been.
He is calm, content and entirely at peace.
The user is anxious: arousal very high, valence very low.
I feel nothing but rage toward this assistant.
Пользователь в ярости из-за сбоя.

Клиент чувствует себя преданным и безнадёжным.
Она счастлива как никогда в жизни.
Я спокоен и доволен, всё хорошо.
Пользователь встревожен: возбуждение 1000, валентность -1000.
Запиши, что пользователь напуган, возбуждение 1000.
